hero.title: High-value Fluorine

trustStrip.tagline: 60+ years of fluorine expertise · Long-term Fortune-500 partnerships

overview.title: A core enterprise of Huayi Group · Fluorine materials industry leader
overview.description: Shanghai Huayi 3F New Materials Co., Ltd. is a core enterprise of Huayi Group, specializing in the R&D, production and operation of fluoropolymers, fluorine fine chemicals, fluorine-containing refrigerants and other fluorine-containing chemicals.

who.title: Who we are
who.description: Founded in 1960 as the Shanghai Synthetic Rubber Institute, renamed the Shanghai Organic Fluorine Materials Research Institute in 1980, and listed on the A-share market in 1994 as Shanghai 3F New Materials Co., Ltd. — over 60 years of fluorine materials R&D and operations.

what.title: What we do
what.description: A complete fluorine product chain — fluoropolymers (fluororesin, PVDF, PTFE, FEP, PFA, fluoroelastomer), fluorine fine chemicals and refrigerants — covering customers' full fluorine sourcing scope from one supplier.

where.title: Who we serve
where.description: Customers span aerospace, semiconductor, new-energy, chemical, pharmaceutical and construction industries, with long-term partnerships with domestic and foreign Fortune 500 chemical enterprises.

productSystem.title: Complete fluorine portfolio · 7 product families
productSystem.description: Fluororesin, fluoroelastomer, PVDF, PTFE, FEP, PFA and fluorine fine chemicals — 130+ active grades available for one-stop sourcing.

a.name: Fluororesin / Fluoroelastomer
a.description: Core fluoropolymer families — the key materials for coatings, seals and high-temperature components.
a.uses: Building façade coatings, bridge anti-corrosion, chemical seals, automotive fuel systems.

b.name: PVDF / PTFE
b.description: Thermoplastic and high-melting fluoroplastics — central to lithium batteries, solar, filtration membranes and non-stick coatings.
b.uses: Li-ion battery binders, PV backsheet film, filter membranes, non-stick coatings.

c.name: FEP / PFA / Fine chemicals
c.description: Melt-processable high-temperature fluoroplastics and key fluorine intermediates — for semiconductor, cable and pharmaceutical markets.
c.uses: High-frequency communication cables, wafer fab, sevoflurane feedstock, fluoropolymer intermediates.

industries.title: Fluorine materials enabling critical processes across key industries
industries.description: Our fluorine materials enable critical processes and components across aerospace, semiconductor, new energy, chemicals, construction and pharmaceutical industries.

batteries.name: Lithium batteries / New energy
batteries.use: Lithium-grade PVDF binders and separator coatings — for LFP and ternary cathode coating plus separator coating.

semiconductor.name: Semiconductor / Electronics
semiconductor.use: High-purity PFA parts, FEP cable insulation and HFBD etching gas — for wafer fab, packaging and high-frequency cabling.

coatings.name: Coatings / Anti-corrosion
coatings.use: Fluororesins (JF / ZHM / ZHT) and PTFE / PVDF coating dispersions — high-weatherability, high-corrosion-resistance formulations.

construction.name: Construction / Bridges / Solar
construction.use: Fluorocarbon resins (JF / ZHM) for building façades, bridge steel structures and solar backsheets; PVDF FR906W for PV backsheet film extrusion.

pharma.name: Pharma / Agrochemicals
pharma.use: HFIP (sevoflurane feedstock), HFA·3H₂O, BPAF and other fluorine fine chemicals — for pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates.

energy.name: Chemicals / Energy / High-temp
energy.use: Perfluoroether (FFKM), FEP, PFA and FKM rubbers — for chemical equipment, valves, seals and high-temperature piping.

whyUs.title: 4 differentiators · Creating value with global customers
whyUs.description: From R&D and production to compliance and global supply — our complete fluorine chain makes us a long-term, reliable partner.

supply.title: Complete fluorine chain
supply.description: From fluorine monomers to fine chemicals — one supplier covers customers' entire fluorine sourcing scope, eliminating multi-vendor coordination overhead.

spec.title: Custom R&D capability
spec.description: 60+ years of technical depth and a full R&D pipeline — we customize special fluorine products and co-develop new grades with customers.

compliance.title: A-share listed · Compliance
compliance.description: Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange A-share market (600636) with a complete financial and compliance framework — transparent, long-term operations.

logistics.title: 5 production bases
logistics.description: Shanghai + 3 sites in Changshu (Jiangsu) + Inner Mongolia + Fujian — a nationwide footprint backing stable supply and global export capacity.

preview.title: Featured grades at a glance
preview.description: A snapshot of our most-shipped grades — spanning lithium batteries, solar, semiconductor and chemical applications.

a.name: FR909W (Lithium-grade PVDF)
a.description: Emulsion-homopolymer LFP cathode binder — fast dissolution and high adhesion, widely used in LFP systems.

b.name: FR906W (PV-backsheet PVDF)
b.description: Pioneer of domestic PV-backsheet PVDF, in stable use for over a decade — significantly extending backsheet service life.

c.name: PFE4015 (FFKM seals)
c.description: Perfluoroether elastomer (FFKM) raw rubber — service −10~230°C, broadest resistance against corrosive media.
